title: Offline sanctions screening, Brazilian identifier validators and payment-code parsers (P219 sanctions_lists, P232 br_validators, P233 boleto_pix)
notes: Core names reused where they fit: sanctioned (only for exact identifier matches: wallet, IMO, registration number, CNPJ), valid, data_attribution, dataset_age, dataset_age_days, country (attributes); sanctions, info, context_only (tags); mentions (relation). sanctions_screening, homonym_risk and name_only_match are re-declared with the exact descriptions of the sibling batch p1-G10-2 (P240/P252) so both batches share one shape. CPFs never appear unmasked in any attribute (AR24, rule 4).

attributes.sanctions_screening: per-list state of an offline sanctions screening {list: {state: no_record | listed | not_screened, file_date, reason}}
attributes.homonym_risk: homonym risk of a name for name-only matches {risk: high | medium | low | unknown, factor, phrase, first_name_tier, common_surname}
attributes.sanctions_matches: candidate entries of an offline sanctions screening (at most 5 per list): [{list, entry_id, listed_name, kind, matched_alias, score, match_type (exact_wallet | exact_cnpj | exact_imo | name), programmes, listing_date, list_date}]; name matches are possible matches to confirm, never verdicts
attributes.sanctions_designation: designation line of a threat actor or entity matched on OFAC/UN/EU lists: '<lists> designated (<date>) - payments may be prohibited, escalate to legal'
attributes.sanctions_history: delisting history of an offline sanctions screening: [{list, match_type (formerly_wallet | formerly_cnpj | formerly_name), entry_id, listed_name (never a natural person), programmes, last_listed (date of the last local list version that carried it), removed_by (date of the first version without it), line 'formerly listed (<date>)'}]
attributes.validity_note: what a check-digit validation means: 'check digits valid (format only)' - never existence, registration, ownership or residence
attributes.formatted_value: canonical punctuated form of an identifier (CNPJ 12.ABC.345/01DE-35, CEP 01001-000)
attributes.cnpj_structure: offline CNPJ structure {root (8 characters shared by every establishment), order (0001 = head office), is_headquarters, hq_cnpj (head-office CNPJ with recomputed check digits), alphanumeric (IN RFB 2.229/2024)}
attributes.cpf_fiscal_region: info-only cross-check 'CPF issued in fiscal region N (UFs)' from the 9th digit: the issuing fiscal region, never the residence
attributes.masked_value: masked display of a personal identifier (CPF ***.456.789-**): the full value never appears in outputs
attributes.plate_forms: Brazilian plate format and its equivalent in the other standard {format old | mercosul, plate, old, mercosul, search_forms}: validation and conversion only, never an owner lookup
attributes.cep_uf_hint: approximate state (UF) of a CEP from the public range table (format check only, existence not checked)
attributes.br_entities: Brazilian entities found in text by the BR rule set (BR Code > boleto > CNJ > CNPJ > PIX key > CPF > phone): [{type, value (never a CPF), display (CPF masked), rule, confidence, checksum_ok, span}]
attributes.pix_key_type: PIX key type determined offline: cpf | cnpj | phone | email | evp (no DICT lookup)
attributes.pix_key: PIX key of a BR Code (CPF keys masked ***.456.789-**)
attributes.pix_verdict: plain-language PIX BR Code line: merchant, city, key type (masked key), txid, amount and CRC status
attributes.pix_merchant_name: merchant name field (59) of a PIX BR Code
attributes.pix_merchant_city: merchant city field (60) of a PIX BR Code
attributes.pix_txid: transaction id (62/05) of a PIX BR Code
attributes.pix_amount: amount field (54) of a PIX BR Code, formatted (R$ 1.234,56)
attributes.pix_crc_status: CRC16/CCITT-FALSE status of a PIX BR Code: 'CRC OK', 'altered or corrupted payload' or 'could not verify (OCR)'
attributes.pix_location_url: dynamic BR Code location as host/*** (masked; never fetched: fetching is a payer-side action that returns payee personal data)
attributes.boleto_verdict: plain-language boleto line: check-digit status, bank, due date and amount, or 'CHECK DIGIT MISMATCH - invalid or altered code (typed or altered line)'
attributes.boleto_facts: decoded boleto {type bancario | arrecadacao, bank_code, bank_name, currency, due {factor, chosen, cycle, old_cycle, new_cycle, ambiguous}, amount, check digits, segment and company id (arrecadacao)}
attributes.bank_tables: bank / ISPB / PIX-participant tables used offline: [{table, source dataset | bundled snapshot, refreshed, stale}]

tags.name_only_match: match on a name alone, without any identifier: 'possible match', lowered by the homonym score (P252)
tags.tampering_suspected: payment code inconsistent with its claimed issuer or payee (possible tampering): never a malicious verdict on its own
tags.formerly_listed: value carried by a previous version of a sanctions list and absent from the current one ('formerly listed (<date>)'): context, never a current designation

relations.pix_key_of: payment code or text -> the PIX key that receives the payment (e-mail, phone or CNPJ; a CPF key is never pivoted)
relations.pix_location_host: dynamic PIX BR Code -> host of its payload location URL (the URL itself is never fetched nor a url entity)
relations.pix_merchant: PIX BR Code -> merchant company name (only for CNPJ keys or legal-suffix names, never a natural person)
relations.headquarters: branch CNPJ -> head-office CNPJ of the same 8-character root (computed offline)
